# fortiappseccloud_waf_graphql_protection

Configures GraphQL protection for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/graphql_protection`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_graphql_protection` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_graphql_protection`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_graphql_protection" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status = true
    action = "alert_deny"

    rule_list {
      item {
        name        = "graphql-default"
        request_url = "/graphql"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `ep_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — Application endpoint ID. Import uses this exact value and it must contain a non-whitespace character.
- `template` (Required) — Whether effective configuration is inherited from the attached template.
- `configs` (Block) — Required when `template = false` and forbidden when `template = true`. State keeps this block null when template inheritance is enabled.
  - `action` (Optional, Computed) — Sets Action. One of `alert`, `alert_deny`, `deny_no_log`. Omission preserves the current value.
  - `status` (Optional, Computed) — Enables or disables GraphQL protection. Omission preserves the current value.
  - Collection ownership — Each block below contains ordered `item` blocks. Omitting a collection block preserves the complete raw remote array and keeps the block null in state. A present empty block sends `[]`. A present block with items replaces the complete array in Terraform order.
    - `rule_list` (Optional Block, at most 10 items) — Owns the ordered `rule_list.item` blocks.
      - `rule_list.item.alias_batch_query` (Optional, Computed) — Alias batch query. Omission preserves the current value.
      - `rule_list.item.alias_batch_query_number` (Optional, Computed, between 0 and 2147483647, default 0) — Alias batch query number.
      - `rule_list.item.array_batch_query` (Optional, Computed) — Array batch query. Omission preserves the current value.
      - `rule_list.item.array_batch_query_number` (Optional, Computed, between 0 and 2147483647, default 0) — Array batch query number.
      - `rule_list.item.field_number` (Optional, Computed, between 0 and 2147483647, default 256) — Field number.
      - `rule_list.item.fragment` (Optional, Computed) — Fragment. Omission preserves the current value.
      - `rule_list.item.graphql_data_size` (Optional, Computed, between 0 and 10240, default 1024) — Graphql data size.
      - `rule_list.item.introspection` (Optional, Computed) — Introspection. Omission preserves the current value.
      - `rule_list.item.name` (Required, maximum 40 UTF-8 characters) — Rule name.
      - `rule_list.item.object_depth` (Optional, Computed, between 0 and 2147483647, default 32) — Object depth.
      - `rule_list.item.request_url` (Required) — Request url.
      - `rule_list.item.value_size` (Optional, Computed, between 0 and 10240, default 256) — Value size.

The wire-only `idx` field is never exposed. The provider regenerates sequential one-based indices independently for each list, validates imported or owned response indices, and sorts state by `idx`. Unknown nested item keys fail closed for owned and imported arrays; omitted top-level collection wrappers remain opaque and are preserved unchanged.


## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_graphql_protection.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
